entities.name: Belenda Danisdotter
entities.description: A human Kjeldoran skyknight and friend of Jaya Ballard who joined Lim-Dul's undead and was ended by Jaya.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Planeswalker Task Mage, friend of Belenda, who ended her undead existence.

entities.name: Fedor Vohnnson
entities.description: Imprisoned Balduvian hunted by a lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Lhurgoyf
entities.description: Creature prowling outside a Kjeldoran city that Jaya dealt with.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: Son of the queen of Kjeldor who ascended after her death.

entities.name: Marton Stromgald
entities.description: Kjeldoran hero who killed Belenda and let Lim-Dul raise her as undead.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Necromancer who raised Belenda as an undead skyknight.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Kingdom whose queen ordered Belenda against the lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Place where Belenda swore her life to Marton Stromgald.

events.summary: Belenda is ordered to get rid of a lhurgoyf; Jaya volunteers in return for Fedor Vohnnson's release order and completes the mission.
events.quote: Jaya completed the mission as promised

events.summary: Belenda falls under the sway of Marton Stromgald and Avram Garrison and vows to join their fight against the Balduvians.
events.quote: Belenda fell under the sway of the Kjeldoran hero

events.summary: Belenda flies Jaya to the Karplusan Mountains, then secretly goes to Tresserhorn and swears her life to Marton, who kills her; Lim-Dul raises her as an undead skyknight.
events.quote: Belenda swore her life to Márton Stromgald, and in return, he killed her

events.summary: In Lim-Dul's Battle Jaya faces undead Belenda and ends her existence; Belenda thanks her as she dies.

relations.note: He killed her at her oath.
relations.quote: he killed her, and let Lim-Dûl raise her as an undead skyknight
let Lim-Dûl raise her as an undead skyknight
